name: Hidaka Manatsu
source:
Arisa's eldest daughter, she is a fun-loving partygoer that still gets good grades. She has many friends and is popular.

Her childhood friend Hiroyuki is the only one who knows the real her. She hopes to use this trip as an opportunity to become his girlfriend. 

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/kk/character.html#Chara02]Official website[/url]]
